name: HEIC for Jelly
description: Makes HEIC/HEIF photos visible and renderable in a Jellyfin photo library.
overview: Adds HEIC support to photo libraries.
changelog: Adds GET /HeicForJelly/Status, a read-only route any signed-in user can call to learn whether this server decodes HEIC and, if not, why (ffmpeg too old or missing). It takes no input and serves no image; photos still go through Jellyfin's own image pipeline only. No change in how photos are resolved, decoded or dated. Requires Jellyfin 10.11.6 or later and ffmpeg 7.0 or newer.
